editorial:
Ever wonder what happens when a one-night stand goes totally wrong? You get a wild ride with Jessica, a woman who simply refuses to leave. After a quick fling with Marcus in his fancy mansion, Jessica decides she likes the lifestyle way too much to go home. Instead of packing her bags, she finds a secret spot to hide inside the house and starts living there like a ghost. You get to watch Marcus and his wife, Milan, go about their perfect lives while this stranger is literally watching their every move from the shadows. It feels like a creepy game of hide-and-seek where the stakes are way higher than a childhood game.

The tension builds up nicely, and the acting makes you really feel for the couple who has no idea their home is invaded. Some parts move a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy stories about obsession and secrets, you will love this.
endingExplained: Everything crashes down when Milan finally discovers Jessica hiding in the house. A violent fight breaks out as Jessica tries to force her way into the couple's life. In the end, Marcus has to choose between his fake perfect image and his wife's safety. He manages to stop Jessica in a final showdown, and she is finally removed from the home. The couple survives, but they are left scarred and unable to ever feel safe in their own house again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers about home intruders and secret obsessions.
